entries.dialogueText: "Don’t be naive, Romus. She must do what’s best for her future, just as I did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must be joking, Uncle.""
entries.dialogueText: "You must be joking, Uncle."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No joke, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "No joke, Romus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I could agree to such terms.""
entries.dialogueText: "I could agree to such terms."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""How should we deal with him, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "How should we deal with him, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'd let me go? After everything..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'd let me go? After everything I did?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then we have an understanding.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then we have an understanding."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I can't let his treachery go unpun..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't let his treachery go unpunished."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You shall be exiled, just as your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You shall be exiled, just as your mother was before you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You never should have been allowed..."
entries.dialogueText: "You never should have been allowed into Rizia in the first place."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You're lucky to be spared this fat..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're lucky to be spared this fate. See to his removal at once, Titus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will not follow him into exile..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will not follow him into exile! I forbid it!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus gave a slight bow before sign..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus gave a slight bow before signaling for his guard, who then took him away.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Please, Your Grace. The reformist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Grace. The reformist movement will not go away. The Crown can't simply ignore it forever--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A tense silence settled over the ro..."
entries.dialogueText: A tense silence settled over the room. Taddeus broke it, wheeling himself toward Hugo.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Exiled?! Now wait a minute...""
entries.dialogueText: "Exiled?! Now wait a minute..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If she wants to throw her life awa..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she wants to throw her life away, that's her choice."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I swore an oath... 'Til death do u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swore an oath... 'Til death do us part.' I'm not leaving you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everything was happening so fast."
entries.dialogueText: Everything was happening so fast.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I straightened my shoulders and lif..."
entries.dialogueText: I straightened my shoulders and lifted my chin as they escorted me out. If this was to be my end, I would face it with the dignity of a king.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Through the rush of it all, I saw V..."
entries.dialogueText: Through the rush of it all, I saw Vina, her mouth wide in shock.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Through the rush of it all, I saw L..."
entries.dialogueText: Through the rush of it all, I saw Lucita frozen in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita frozen in disbelief."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita frozen in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Through the rush of it all, I saw M..."
entries.dialogueText: Through the rush of it all, I saw Mother, watching helplessly as I was taken away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And Mother, watching helplessly as..."
entries.dialogueText: And Mother, watching helplessly as I was taken away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the guards dragged me out, Titus..."
entries.dialogueText: As the guards dragged me out, Titus's voice cut through the struggle.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""All Hail King Hugo.""
entries.dialogueText: "All Hail King Hugo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall erupted with the same cry,..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall erupted with the same cry, sealing my fate.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Through the rush of it all, I saw P..."
entries.dialogueText: Through the rush of it all, I saw Pabel frozen in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel frozen in disbelief."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel frozen in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina consoled my mother as tears be..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina consoled my mother as tears began to fall from her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus took Vina in his arms as tear..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus took Vina in his arms as tears began to fall from my daughter's eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If that's how you feel, I will not..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's how you feel, I will not stop you from accompanying your husband."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina rushed to Manus and held him t..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina rushed to Manus and held him tightly.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Don’t pretend you have any authori..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t pretend you have any authority over me!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Don’t pretend you have any authori..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t pretend you have any authority over me after everything you've done!"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""No, Vina. He's right. Listen to yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Vina. He's right. Listen to your father."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Have you lost your senses, Romus?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you lost your senses, Romus? She will do no such thing!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What say you?""
entries.dialogueText: "What say you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are the king. As it should be.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are the king. As it should be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your act of 'benevolence' means no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your act of 'benevolence' means nothing to me. I will not grovel before you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not kneel. Even for my fami..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not kneel. Even for my family's sake, I cannot betray what I know to be right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not kneel to you or any oth..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not kneel to you or any other so-called monarch. The age of kings is over."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I offered you a choice, but you ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I offered you a choice, but you have forced my hand."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Titus, see that the king's decree..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, see that the king's decree is fulfilled."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rough hands seized me with a brutal..."
entries.dialogueText: Rough hands seized me with a brutality that stripped away my last vestiges of power.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "My heels scraped uselessly against..."
entries.dialogueText: My heels scraped uselessly against the marble floor as I fought -- each movement more desperate than the last.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita stepped forward, head high a..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita stepped forward, head high and strides deliberate.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So, this is how you repay me, Luci..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, this is how you repay me, Lucita? A bow to the man who took everything from us?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You misunderstand my intentions, R..."
entries.dialogueText: "You misunderstand my intentions, Romus. I'm here to state before everyone here that I have no intention of kneeling before anyone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's my girl. Tell it to him str..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's my girl. Tell it to him straight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you doing?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you doing?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I could never kneel to him while y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I could never kneel to him while you still stand. I couldn't live with myself."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's not the kind of sacrifice I..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not the kind of sacrifice I'm willing to make. You’re my father! I could never kneel to him while you still stand. I couldn't live with myself."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You married me to Ricardus so Hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "You married me to Ricardus so House Toras would stay on the throne. And that's exactly what's going to happen."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You think I want to kneel next to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think I want to kneel next to you, Rico? Fine. But don’t think for a second I’m doing this for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: She turned to me.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Not anymore.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not anymore."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The House nobles didn't betray the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The House nobles didn't betray their kingdom. You did."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""If these allegations are true, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "If these allegations are true, then needless to say I am shocked and outraged."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Alright, Vina. That's enough. This..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright, Vina. That's enough. This isn't the time for defiance."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""But Pales will not unify with a Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Pales will not unify with a Rizia ruled by King Hugo Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several Wruhec's Guardians seized m..."
entries.dialogueText: Several Wruhec's Guardians seized me by the arms and propelled me forward. Lucita rushed at them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several Wruhec's Guardians seized m..."
entries.dialogueText: Several Wruhec's Guardians seized me by the arms and dragged me into the adjoining room.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Rizian nobles, hear me. I have ded..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizian nobles, hear me. I have dedicated my life to serving the Crown, but today I stand before you with a heavy heart."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As you already know, the king brou..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you already know, the king brought you here tonight to compel the leaders of your respective Houses to sign a new Rizian constitution--"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""One that would strip you of your t..."
entries.dialogueText: "One that would strip you of your titles, lands, privileges, and ancestral rights."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""A constitution that aims to disman..."
entries.dialogueText: "A constitution that aims to dismantle centuries of tradition and the monarchy itself."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""And if you refused, he intended to..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if you refused, he intended to secure your consent by force."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's lying!""
entries.dialogueText: "He's lying!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are completely out of line, Ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are completely out of line, Titus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I said nothing."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He told me so himself.""
entries.dialogueText: "He told me so himself."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It’s in moments like these that tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s in moments like these that true character is revealed. Shame on you for turning on my father in his darkest hours!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No! Don’t try to turn this around..."
entries.dialogueText: "No! Don’t try to turn this around on me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And then, to my shock, Vina approac..."
entries.dialogueText: And then, to my shock, Vina approached Hugo.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You would betray your own father?""
entries.dialogueText: "You would betray your own father?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have every right to be disappo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have every right to be disappointed with my actions here today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After everything I've done for you..."
entries.dialogueText: "After everything I've done for you, this is how you repay me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Not only have you shattered the tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only have you shattered the trust of the people but also my trust in you. I can't follow someone who has lost their way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't respond to her."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't respond to her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was trying to save Rizia from it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was trying to save Rizia from itself. You just don’t see the bigger picture."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If my own daughter sees me as a fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "If my own daughter sees me as a failure, then perhaps you are no daughter of mine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With that, she knelt before Hugo an..."
entries.dialogueText: With that, she knelt before Hugo and swore her allegiance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Everything I did was for the good..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything I did was for the good of the kingdom and for you. I only hope, in time, you’ll understand."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Even now your arrogance continues..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even now your arrogance continues to blind you. Your 'bigger picture' is nothing more than an illusion."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If that's what you think, then you..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's what you think, then you've lost more than just your way."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Good intentions won’t erase the da..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good intentions won’t erase the damage you've done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With tears in her eyes, she knelt b..."
entries.dialogueText: With tears in her eyes, she knelt before Hugo and swore her allegiance.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""'Disappointed?' That's putting it..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Disappointed?' That's putting it lightly."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Don't make this about me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't make this about me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You think your position is secure?..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think your position is secure? People like you don't tend to last long."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’m sure you’ll make a fine king....."
entries.dialogueText: "I’m sure you’ll make a fine king... for about five minutes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a knee and swore his allegi..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a knee and swore his allegiance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Best of luck to you, Cousin.""
entries.dialogueText: "Best of luck to you, Cousin."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With tears in her eyes, she knelt b..."
entries.dialogueText: With tears in her eyes, she knelt before Hugo. Axel joined her, and together they swore their allegiance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With that, she knelt before Hugo. A..."
entries.dialogueText: With that, she knelt before Hugo. Axel joined her, and together they swore their allegiance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita stepped back and stood by my..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita stepped back and stood by my side.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The doors of the grand hall swung o..."
entries.dialogueText: The doors of the grand hall swung open. Sevrio Castellanus and a team of Wruhec's Guardians rushed inside, quickly spreading out to secure the room.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Right is defined by the oath I swo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right is defined by the oath I swore -- to defend the Crown's true purpose, not the whims of a single monarch."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Rectifying a wrong that should hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rectifying a wrong that should have never occurred."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""The room is secure. By God's grace..."
entries.dialogueText: "The room is secure. By God's grace, the Guardians stand ready."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The man I swore to protect, King R..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man I swore to protect, King Romus, intended to strike against House Toras -- his own blood."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I witnessed his malice myself. I b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I witnessed his malice myself. I begged him to resolve his disputes with House Toras through words.'"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I never meant to harm you, nor Vin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never meant to harm you, nor Vina. House Toras had become a threat, and I had no choice but to act."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Titus shook his head.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You forced my hand, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "You forced my hand, Romus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was Titus' idea! He forced me i..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was Titus' idea! He forced me into it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm only a humble guardsman. I can..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm only a humble guardsman. I cannot force the King to do anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't believe it... this can't b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't believe it... this can't be happening..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Believe it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Believe it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But he dismissed my counsel, inten..."
entries.dialogueText: "But he dismissed my counsel, intent on resorting to violent means."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I did not want to risk bringing vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not want to risk bringing violence upon myself, so I went along with his plan. I even advised him on it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Today, I hope to rectify that mist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, I hope to rectify that mistake by shielding Rizia from a king who has placed his selfish desires above the needs of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It belongs to the rightful king of..."
entries.dialogueText: "It belongs to the rightful king of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Romus. You wouldn't really be so b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus. You wouldn't really be so boneheaded as to attack your own family?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't listen to him, Mother! Titus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't listen to him, Mother! Titus is lying. He just wants to overthrow me, to take the throne for himself!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I have no interest in the throne,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no interest in the throne, Your Majesty. It is not mine to take."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I ignored my mother and instead, tu..."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored my mother and instead, turned my attention to the guards.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After all I've done, this is how I..."
entries.dialogueText: "After all I've done, this is how I’m repaid?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Dear God... it *is* true.""
entries.dialogueText: "Dear God... it *is* true."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I stand by my husband -- the fathe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand by my husband -- the father of my child -- and the rightful king of Rizia. My fate is sealed with his."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Very well. His path will be determ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. His path will be determined soon enough."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I first grew suspicious when the k..."
entries.dialogueText: "I first grew suspicious when the king began acting outside the usual protocols, such as dismissing advice and taking meetings behind closed doors."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""When I dug deeper, I discovered he..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I dug deeper, I discovered he had been secretly conspiring to implement the radical reforms I spoke of."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As a sworn protector of the Crown,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a sworn protector of the Crown, I could not allow this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked to Captain Castellanus. He..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked to Captain Castellanus. He stood stock-still.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Divine protector of Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Divine protector of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother let out a small gasp as Titu..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother let out a small gasp as Titus turned to Hugo and bowed deeply before him. Sevrio did the same.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Please, Your Majesty, you're only..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty, you're only making this worse for yourself."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""They only take orders from the rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "They only take orders from the rightful king of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The king brought you here tonight..."
entries.dialogueText: "The king brought you here tonight to force the leaders of your respective Houses to abolish the Rizian monarchy."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Instead, he envisioned the complet..."
entries.dialogueText: "Instead, he envisioned the complete dismantling of the existing order -- stripping you of your titles, lands, privileges, and ancestral rights."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He has been collaborating in secre..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has been collaborating in secret with the terrorist leader, Adarfo Sotelato, and his criminal organization to achieve his aims."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus halted directly in front of m..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus halted directly in front of me. His men lined up behind him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But instead of moving toward the as..."
entries.dialogueText: But instead of moving toward the assembled nobles, Sevrio halted directly in front of me. His men lined up behind him.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He tried to leak the security plan..."
entries.dialogueText: "He tried to leak the security plans of today's gathering to armed extremists."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He tried to sneak armed extremists..."
entries.dialogueText: "He tried to sneak armed extremists into today's gathering. Disguised as kitchen staff."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He has been collaborating in secre..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has been collaborating in secret with foreign agents to achieve his aims."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He tried to involve Arcasian agent..."
entries.dialogueText: "He tried to involve Arcasian agents to strike you at today's gathering."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And the last thing I wanted was to..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the last thing I wanted was to allow a bloodthirsty Malenyevist to run roughshod over the country."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It was his intention to abdicate t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was his intention to abdicate the throne, but he never planned to appoint a successor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you waiting for? Attack!""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you waiting for? Attack!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is something the matter, Captain G..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is something the matter, Captain Gordion?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Everyone remain right where you ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone remain right where you are. Your reckoning is at hand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus looked me straight in the eye..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus looked me straight in the eye. He spoke slowly.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What you do not know is that he wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "What you do not know is that he was counting on you to refuse. All along, his intention was to secure your consent by force."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What I want is your fealty to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I want is your fealty to the rightful king of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't understand. You and House..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't understand. You and House Toras supported the reforms."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I did until you proved you were wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did until you proved you were willing to stoop to violence to force your agenda."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I would have gladly supported your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have gladly supported your reforms. But not after you proved you were willing to stoop to violence to force your agenda."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I did not support your reforms, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not support your reforms, but I would have been willing to help implement them if the other Houses insisted. But then you proved you were willing to stoop to violence to force your agenda."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I lashed out at Titus with my fist...."
entries.dialogueText: I lashed out at Titus with my fist. He dodged it deftly, then signaled to his men to remove the ring from my finger by force.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I removed the royal signet ring and..."
entries.dialogueText: I removed the royal signet ring and placed it in Titus's palm. He turned and knelt before Hugo, presenting the ring to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I lashed out with my fist. It conne..."
entries.dialogueText: I lashed out with my fist. It connected with Titus' lower right side, where his old boxing injury was.
entries.menuText: Hit him in his weak spot.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned and knelt before Hugo, pr..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned and knelt before Hugo, presenting the ring to him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As he collapsed to the floor in pai..."
entries.dialogueText: As he collapsed to the floor in pain, his guardsmen swarmed me, raining blows until I was forced to give up the ring.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a groan, Titus rose and presen..."
entries.dialogueText: With a groan, Titus rose and presented it to Hugo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As he collapsed to the floor in pai..."
entries.dialogueText: As he collapsed to the floor in pain, Sevrio and his guardsmen swarmed me, raining blows until I was forced to give up the ring.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She kissed the ring."
entries.dialogueText: She kissed the ring.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus remained standing, a conflict..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus remained standing, a conflicted look on his face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before he could act, Titus grabbed..."
entries.dialogueText: Before he could act, Titus grabbed him by the shoulders.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Not so fast, Mr. Sazon. You're no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not so fast, Mr. Sazon. You're no less complicit than our former king."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""What do you mean? I had no idea of..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean? I had no idea of His Majesty's plans."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I advised His Majesty not to go do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I advised His Majesty not to go down the path of violence. He didn't listen."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But yes, I collaborated with King..."
entries.dialogueText: "But yes, I collaborated with King Romus on the reforms. And I stand by them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You were the one who started this..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were the one who started this movement. Sotelato may have radicalized it, but he was riding your coattails."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You would've betrayed the Rizian c..."
entries.dialogueText: "You would've betrayed the Rizian crown and everything it stands for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You took my daughter away. I hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "You took my daughter away. I hope you're happy, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go on, you two. You'll be better o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go on, you two. You'll be better off outside of Rizia than in it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""See, Titus? Not everyone in this r..."
entries.dialogueText: "See, Titus? Not everyone in this room recognizes Hugo as their king."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We will see about that. General Ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will see about that. General Taddeus?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter looked at me tearfully."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter looked at me tearfully.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""She had every chance to stay.""
entries.dialogueText: "She had every chance to stay."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded resolutely."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded resolutely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita and Carlos followed suit, sw..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita and Carlos followed suit, swearing loyalty to the new monarch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos followed suit, swearing loya..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos followed suit, swearing loyalty to the new monarch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos did the same."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos did the same.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""When we reclaim Pales, we will do..."
entries.dialogueText: "When we reclaim Pales, we will do so in the name of King Hugo Toras."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As it should be, traitor.""
entries.dialogueText: "As it should be, traitor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew Queen Lucita would not stan..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew Queen Lucita would not stand for this nonsense."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was Queen Consort Lucita's idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was Queen Consort Lucita's idea."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gasps rippled through the room as e..."
entries.dialogueText: Gasps rippled through the room as everyone turned towards my wife.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The King and Queen conspired to ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King and Queen conspired to carry out this act together. They deserve each other."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As it should be.""
entries.dialogueText: "As it should be."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You had the chance to transform th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had the chance to transform the country, and instead you schemed against your own family. I can't follow someone who's lost their way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Axel exchanged glances. Axe..."
entries.dialogueText: She and Axel exchanged glances. Axel gave a nod of confirmation.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""But I side with my Duchess. Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I side with my Duchess. Pales will not recognize Hugo Toras as king."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Estela took her hand."
entries.dialogueText: Estela took her hand.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""My lot's been cast already, darlin..."
entries.dialogueText: "My lot's been cast already, darling. Your uncle never wanted me in the royal family, anyway."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But you still have a chance to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you still have a chance to be queen. There's no telling what will happen to your cousin, after all."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Is that a threat, auntie?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that a threat, auntie?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But you still have a chance to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you still have a chance to be queen. In the very likely event that your disgraced cousin doesn't procreate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No! The reunification must go as p..."
entries.dialogueText: "No! The reunification must go as planned! It's my legacy!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand your decision, Duke R..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your decision, Duke Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Just as I hope you understand that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as I hope you understand that I will not recognize Vina Toras' claim to the throne. When I die, Hubertus Toras and his family will be next in line."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Just as I hope you understand that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as I hope you understand that I will not recognize Vina Toras' claim to the throne. Should anything happen to my son, Hubertus Toras and his family will be next in line."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I believe this betrayal will be yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe this betrayal will be your legacy. Dad."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. Keep my daughter safe in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Keep my daughter safe in the Grand Duchy."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You two are both delusional. Pledg..."
entries.dialogueText: "You two are both delusional. Pledge your support to Hugo, and all will be well."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father, no! How can you ask us to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father, no! How can you ask us to do that?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Fine. I don't care what happens in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I don't care what happens in this sham of a kingdom."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Vina, please! Don't throw your fut..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, please! Don't throw your future away. Swear your allegiance to your uncle."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""My son's reputation will be rehabi..."
entries.dialogueText: "My son's reputation will be rehabilitated. But your mother speaks the truth, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Recognize me as the rightful King..."
entries.dialogueText: "Recognize me as the rightful King of Rizia, and you will keep your title and your place in the line of succession."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You truly don't know my daughter i..."
entries.dialogueText: "You truly don't know my daughter if you think she wants to remain part of the monarchy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, I beg you, if you don't want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, I beg you, if you don't want to do it for yourself, do it for me. I’ll carry no resentment in my heart."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel joined her."
entries.dialogueText: Axel joined her.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stood next to Axel and folded h..."
entries.dialogueText: She stood next to Axel and folded her arms.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She folded her arms and glared at R..."
entries.dialogueText: She folded her arms and glared at Rico.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Valenqiris needs their Duchess, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valenqiris needs their Duchess, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She folded her arms."
entries.dialogueText: She folded her arms.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I will not be a Duchess in service..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not be a Duchess in service to the man who usurped my father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I am the Grand Duchess of Pales. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am the Grand Duchess of Pales. That's the only title I need, and you can't take it away from me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No title is worth staying married..."
entries.dialogueText: "No title is worth staying married to this idiot while serving his usurper of a father."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You rat. You can't say those words..."
entries.dialogueText: "You rat. You can't say those words and expect to live."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's expression betrayed no anger..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's expression betrayed no anger.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your loyalty to your father is tou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your loyalty to your father is touching, Your Highness. I would have made the same choice in your place."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Go to Pales. Go, and never set foo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go to Pales. Go, and never set foot on Rizian soil again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She let out a giggle."
entries.dialogueText: She let out a giggle.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The revolution's going to eat you..."
entries.dialogueText: "The revolution's going to eat you all alive, anyway."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But I cannot let you stay in Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "But I cannot let you stay in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One by one, the others in the room..."
entries.dialogueText: One by one, the others in the room pledged their loyalty to the new king until only my mother and I were left.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She rushed to Manus' side and embra..."
entries.dialogueText: She rushed to Manus' side and embraced him tenderly.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Now that I'm not a princess, none..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that I'm not a princess, none of you can stop me from being with the man I love."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Please, Hugo. He's my only son.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Hugo. He's my only son."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If his plans had succeeded, he wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "If his plans had succeeded, he would've gotten us all killed."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He would have destroyed House Tora..."
entries.dialogueText: "He would have destroyed House Toras. Valero's legacy!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""By all rights, he should spend the..."
entries.dialogueText: "By all rights, he should spend the rest of his life in prison."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go on, I dare you to do it. Bring..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go on, I dare you to do it. Bring even more shame upon your house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You hypocrite. You beg me for a pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You hypocrite. You beg me for a pardon for your son, then send me to jail?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am the true king of Rizia! My fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am the true king of Rizia! My followers will not stand for this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't you understand? It doesn't m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you understand? It doesn't matter! The revolutionaries will have all of our heads!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I regret nothing.""
entries.dialogueText: "I regret nothing."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The revolutionaries will calm down..."
entries.dialogueText: "The revolutionaries will calm down once Rizia is governed by a reasonable and just king."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Few in this room have accepted you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Few in this room have accepted your treachery. What makes you think the kingdom will?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I said you *should* be imprisoned...."
entries.dialogueText: "I said you *should* be imprisoned. Not that you will."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If that was how I treated members..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that was how I treated members of my own family, I'd be no better than you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps not today, but someday, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps not today, but someday, you will come to see the error of your ways."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sorrow and compassion mixed in his..."
entries.dialogueText: Sorrow and compassion mixed in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Here is what I can offer you. Reco..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here is what I can offer you. Recognize me as king of Rizia and shed your claim to the throne, and I will let you leave the kingdom in peace."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You may join your daughter and her..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may join your daughter and her paramour in exile."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You may join your daughter in exil..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may join your daughter in exile."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""And his co-conspirator, Duchess Az..."
entries.dialogueText: "And his co-conspirator, Duchess Azaro? I don't trust her one bit."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""She shall be exiled as well. Witho..."
entries.dialogueText: "She shall be exiled as well. Without the Azaros to back her, she will not be a danger."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your wife is free to go as well. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your wife is free to go as well. Presuming the child she is carrying never sets foot on Rizian soil again."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your... friend is free to go as we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your... friend is free to go as well. And I suggest he take the chance, before such perversions as yours and his are once more outlawed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel glared at him."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel glared at him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita glared at him."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita glared at him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother walked over to stand besi..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother walked over to stand beside me.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You've gotten what you've always w..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've gotten what you've always wanted, Hugo. The stain of commoner blood has been washed out of the Toras lineage."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Romus will obey your order. And I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus will obey your order. And I'll accompany him to make sure he stays out of trouble."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Isn't that right, Romus?""
entries.dialogueText: "Isn't that right, Romus?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her voice was tinged with desperati..."
entries.dialogueText: Her voice was tinged with desperation.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unlike you, humor isn't my strong..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unlike you, humor isn't my strong suit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've got to leave Rizia as well,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've got to leave Rizia as well, Hugo. I'm telling you, if we don't give the reformists what they want, everyone in this room will die."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You'd like that, wouldn't you?""
entries.dialogueText: "You'd like that, wouldn't you?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo shook his head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll die before I cede the throne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll die before I cede the throne to you."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Then you'll die.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then you'll die."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""No!""
entries.dialogueText: "No!"

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If you had your way, you would've..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you had your way, you would've killed my family along with your uncle's."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I believe that's grounds for divor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe that's grounds for divorce."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She knelt before Hugo."
entries.dialogueText: She knelt before Hugo.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I pledge my support..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I pledge my support to you and cede my future child's claim to the Rizian throne. As long as you can guarantee our safety."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded gravely."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded gravely.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You, your family and your child wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You, your family and your child will all be safe, Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There's nothing left for us here,..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's nothing left for us here, Romus. I'll follow you wherever you go."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Rizia will fall under your reign...."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia will fall under your reign. Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not so fast, Mr. Sazon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not so fast, Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus hesitantly stepped forward."
entries.dialogueText: Manus hesitantly stepped forward.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I know of your intentions against..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know of your intentions against the monarchy and the Toras dynasty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""What do you mean? I had no idea of..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean? I had no idea of His Majesty's plans."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Because you have your own grand pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because you have your own grand plans, Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If given the opportunity, you woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "If given the opportunity, you would've betrayed the Rizian crown and everything it stands for."

entries.dialogueText: "I apologize, Your Grace, but my duties are to the King of Rizia. And I will continue to serve him, wherever he goes."
